h:
对于那些刚刚起步、想要一个简单的工作流程来生成带有详细面部的大型高质量图像的人。另外，当生成较大批次时，您可以通过选择哪些图片亮起绿灯以进行细节处理和升级来节省一些时间！

我自己对 ComfyUI 还很陌生，所以我知道大多数“简单工作流程”是多么令人困惑，所以我真的尽力将其简化为我认为开始获得好照片的基本要素。只需下载缺少的节点并使用您选择的升级器和 VAE。如果您不确定，只需搜索我正在使用的那些，到目前为止它们对我来说效果很好。

V1.1

加载工作流程时，任何地方的节点似乎都不起作用，因此我上传了一个没有它们的版本。它不太整洁，但做的事情都是一样的。

V1.0

  • 提示和样式节点

  • 检查点、VAE 和多个 Lora 加载器

  • 基本渲染设置

  • 图像过滤器（选择您想要精炼和放大的图片）

  • 面部细节师

  • 升级者

  • 图像比较

o.en:
For those just starting out who want a simple workflow to generate large high-quality images with detailed faces. Plus, when generating larger batches, you save some time by choosing which pictures are greenlit to go through the detailer and upscaling!

I'm pretty new to ComfyUI myself, so I know how confusing most of the "Simple Workflows" are, so I really did my best to simplify this to what I think are base essentials to start getting good pictures. Just download the missing nodes and use the upscaler and VAE of your choice. If you're not sure, just search for the ones I'm using, they've worked pretty well for me so far.

V1.1

The anything everywhere nodes seemed to not work when loading the workflow, so I uploaded a version without them. It's less neat, but does all the same things.

V1.0

  • Prompt & Styling node

  • Checkpoint, VAE and multiple Lora loaders

  • Basic render settings

  • Image filter (choose which pictures you want to be refined and upscaled)

  • Face detailer

  • Upscaler

  • Image comparisons
